create.name: Dr. Chelsea Jackson Roberts
create.bio:
Dr. Chelsea Jackson Roberts has taught yoga since 2002. Her classes lean towards slow flow and restorative practice, often set to hip-hop, R&B and electronic music, and are built so that people of any body type or experience can take part and feel they belong. She holds a doctorate in educational studies from Emory University, where her research explored how yoga, literacy and storytelling meet, and she uses the term inner literacy for the self-knowledge she encourages through movement, breath, meditation and reflection.

In 2014 she started Yoga, Literature and Art Camp, a summer programme for teenage girls at the Spelman College Museum of Fine Art in Atlanta, and she founded Red Clay Yoga, which trains teachers to share yoga with young people and marginalised communities. She has taught on the faculty of Off the Mat, Into the World and travelled widely as a global yoga ambassador for lululemon. Today she teaches live and on-demand yoga and meditation as a Peloton instructor, speaks at events including TEDxHarlem, and has twice appeared on the cover of Yoga Journal. Her Commune course gives ten short days of gentle yoga, meditation and journaling to help people build a practice at home.

courses.title: Ignite Your Yoga Practice
courses.description: Ten days of gentle slow-flow yoga, each paired with a short meditation and a journaling exercise, plus bonus videos on working with blocks, straps and blankets. It is meant to help beginners and returning students settle into a regular home practice.

flags: Name kept as 'Dr. Chelsea Jackson Roberts' (PhD, Emory), which is how she presents everywhere (her site, Commune, TEDx); slug chelsea-jackson-roberts.
Most of her current teaching is on Peloton (members only); no Peloton offering added because there is no page of her own there and the subscription is Peloton's product.

Only one offering (Commune) and no books or free resources; the page rests on the Commune course and eight videos, all on other channels (lululemon, Commune, Peloton, WWF, TEDx), where she is the sole teacher.

A YouTube channel @chelseajacksonyoga ('Chelsea Jackson', 126 subscribers) has yoga and meditation videos that are probably hers, but it is not linked from her site and its avatar is not a clear photo; not used, not counted.
Faculty member of Off the Mat, Into the World with Seane Corn (listed on Spiritpedia) and Hala Khouri (rank 25, skipped).
TikTok count read from the public profile page's data (no og:description); Instagram alone already puts her in luminary.
Second photo is from her own site and looks like a lululemon campaign shot; first is the Commune headshot. Same person.
